title: stonesiella selaginoides
intro: Stonesiella selaginoides, commonly known as Stonecrop, is a succulent plant species that belongs to the Crassulaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include treating digestive issues, such as constipation and diarrhea, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Stonesiella selaginoides include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its potential in wound healing and skin care. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal and therapeutic effects.
